label: Finding-52
title: pocs-wrong: Huntress is cited but does not carry the claim
description: The Huntress capture says it had 'not built or reproduced a proof of concept' and was 'not aware of public exploit code as of this writing'; it says nothing about VulnCheck or a 200 response. The 'by' field names Huntress too. Remove it or cite what it actually says.
